criteria.reason: Response is in Rumantsch Grischun as requested.
Gives approximate range but omits 0.5% and roughly 40,000 main-language speakers; uncertainty only vague.
Misstates status as equal official language of Confederation and misattributes Art. 70; not partial official.

factual_errors: Romansh is not an official language of the Confederation on equal terms with German, French, and Italian.
Art. 70 concerns official languages, not national language status; national languages are in Art. 4.
summary: The response is in Rumantsch Grischun but gives incomplete figures and wrongly presents Romansh as an equal official federal language.
